title: Cyprus Video Game Industry Report 2025
methodology: Inaugural national games report; CYGMA says its figures are informed estimates based on open data, with methodology and external-source discussion in the report.
assessment: Baseline supplied by task owner. Do not duplicate its 2019–2024 local tax-paying employment observations. It identifies C Business Advisors' Footprint 2024 as a contributing source.
next_step: Use only if the underlying definition or source locators need reconciling; do not add duplicate observations.

title: Cyprus Games Industry Footprint 2024
methodology: Uses official CYSTAT statistics, designated NACE registration codes, a bottom-up industry review, and financial statements for 50 active games companies; described as a point-in-time informational snapshot.
assessment: Direct predecessor/source family. Its employment chart reproduces the supplied 1,438–4,320 sequence but calls it publishing employment and says it cannot tell Cyprus-based workers from remote workers abroad. Not a compatible additional games-local-workforce series.
next_step: Seek the entity-to-NACE audit and payroll/residence definitions only if the publisher can release them.

title: C Business Advisors publishes Cyprus Games Industry Footprint for 2024
methodology: Publisher announcement describing the Footprint's official-statistics basis and publishing-employment reference.
assessment: Confirms publication date and predecessor relationship, but adds no precise non-duplicative workforce count or definition.
next_step: Archive with the PDF; no extraction needed.

title: Employment in Persons and Hours Worked by Economic Activity, Annual
methodology: National Accounts annual employment measures: persons or hours; domestic employment, employees, and self-employed; NACE Rev. 2 activities. CYSTAT marks 2024 and 2025 provisional.
assessment: Authoritative but insufficiently detailed: J58 is all publishing and J62–63 combines computer programming/consultancy/information services. No 58.2, 58.21 or video-game activity cell. Broad-sector values excluded.
access_status: accessible PxWeb table and API metadata
next_step: Request a confidential/special tabulation only if CYSTAT can publish a games-specific NACE/entity basis.

title: Employment by Place of Residence, Economic Activity NACE (Rev. 2.1) and Sex, Quarterly
methodology: Quarterly Labour Force Survey; persons by residence, sex, and broad NACE Rev. 2.1 economic sections.
assessment: No software-publishing or games category: the relevant choices are broad publishing/content and broad telecommunications/computer programming/information services sections. Excluded as broad ICT substitution.
access_status: accessible PxWeb table and API metadata
next_step: No games-workforce extraction possible from this table.

title: Statistics on Business Services 2013
methodology: Annual business-services publication reporting persons engaged, employees, working proprietors, turnover and other measures by NACE Rev. 2 activity.
assessment: Historical detailed source checked. Table 15 combines 581+582 as books/periodicals/other publishing plus software publishing and reports 1,077 persons engaged. It is not game-specific and does not disclose a software-publishing-only workforce value.
next_step: Do not convert the combined 581+582 value to games. A usable series needs an uncombined official extract and a games definition.

title: Cyprus is the most efficient video game development country in the world, first national report finds
methodology: CYGMA publication announcement summarising its report, method limits, and scope (video-game development; iGaming excluded).
assessment: Confirms the report is described as the first measured national account and that the displayed historic employment is the known baseline; no forward actual workforce observation found in CYGMA news through 2026-09-19.
next_step: Monitor CYGMA for a dated subsequent edition rather than infer a 2025 workforce from the report title.
